title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Anbu's attempts to get closer to Kanmani fail as she responds angrily. Meanwhile, Vennila notices signs of Rajasekar waking from his coma and acts to protect her secret.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Kalamma calms Siddharth while Kumaresan and Ganthimathi shop for gifts. Siddharth rejects Nalini's invite, but Paraman urges him to attend the nuptial chain function.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Vethanayagam helps Vetri find a job despite Karna's threats. Later, Magesh visits Vetri, and Sudar promises to talk to Magesh after Abinaya's advice.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Pechi refuses to live with Manjamalai and leaves for Mayandi's home. Meenatchi returns home and pours water over herself, heartbroken by the humiliation.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Suresh thanks Mathi for taking Lakshmi to the hospital. Meanwhile, Thangaraj happily accepts the dietitian's plan after Revathi urges him to choose Idlis over Parotta.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Meena calls Thangamayil to check on her stay plans. Later, Senthil scolds Meena for interfering in Thangamayil's divorce issue as the family questions their fight.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Aneesh tells Chozhan about Rajbeer's trouble and asks him to keep it from Cheran. Chozhan grows worried as Chandayatha's family struggles to reach Chennai due to transport issues.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Rohini shares a final embrace with Manoj, expressing her love before parting. Later, Meena and Shruthi's vomiting raises false pregnancy hopes, disappointing the family.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Tamizhselvi gratefully thanks Mari for helping her get the required loan sanctioned. Sethupathi is stunned by the tender loss and suspects that the details were secretly leaked.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Arjun saves a girl from a boy's forced marriage attempt, regretting his reaction to Madhu. Aadhavan is shocked when Sankar shows Pooja's photo and asks him to trace her.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
episodeTitle: A Secret Feast at Kandhasamy's Home
description: Kandhasamy and his sons secretly bring home biryani to treat their wives. Each buys incense sticks to hide the aroma, creating hilarious chaos as their identical tricks collide.

title: Bigg Boss The Common Man
episodeTitle: The Common Man: Red vs Blue Team
description: Darwin shines in the memory challenge, while Manivannan impresses in the physical tasks. As the teams continue to battle, the elimnation leaves everyone teary eyed.
